known_failures_and_recovery: Source installer initially exceeded Windows remote command line length; repaired by sending code and arguments through native Windows SSH stdin. Existing uploaded packages reused.
Support verification had the same command line length limit; existing copied packs were reused, with fresh SHA verification on both hosts.
SSH session closure killed the initially spawned controller. Native deployment now breaks away from the SSH job; verified persistence and external access after disconnect.

First archive cleanup rejected the other known service ZIP binding; matched first group removed, unmatched group retained. Remaining group subsequently matched against the original project ZIP and removed. Model files/runtime unaffected.

First actual Q2_0 startup exposed omitted CUDA wheel installation. No generation was submitted. Installer now installs full pinned set; all three quantizations subsequently passed twelve short requests.
boundaries: No actual GPU/model inference in this deployment phase. File/source/control checks do not prove capacity or generation correctness. Raw temporary details are not retained here; deleting them prevents replaying installer or transport logs. Compact numbers and SHA bindings remain sufficient to verify these deployment totals.
dependency_followup: See validation.json: CUDA wheels were omitted by initial requirements-only installation, then installed offline and verified during approved short acceptance.
